adaptation.compaction: buildCompactionPrompt is the full official default compact instruction adapted to summary-only output in the existing DSH compaction transaction.

nativeWorkflow.differences: The existing native JavaScript body/meta path remains available. Role-specific instructions use real native children without forcing a team. The original TypeScript Actor facade/typechecking/static graphs are implemented separately by typedWorkflowAdapter; original graph amendment and engine run-journal semantics are not supplied by the native JavaScript path.

nativeSessionContext.hostIntegration: Public cold-safe sessionController.inspect; native user/assistant/tool result parts only. Original ranking/chunk/format/budget helper compiled at build with native part boundary. Configured same DSH route extraction, bounded local fallback; no session activation/appends or separate history.

nativeSessionContext.differences: Same configured DSH model instead of official lite route; native persisted events instead of ZCode active tree; source model label truthful; incomplete extraction falls back.

omdEnhancementAdaptation.runtime: Same DSH loop and session; compatible OMD workflow implementation selected once in the existing private delegation realm, never two active engines.

compiler.sourceScope: Fixed original compiler/analysis/schema/lowering/facade closure and build/export files; engine/hash.ts is a dependency-free JSON helper only. No WorkflowEngine, Actor scheduler, provider/account runtime or CLI is bundled.

typescript.generation: Same reference-lib closure as the fixed upstream generator, emitted through an esbuild virtual module at build time. Original declaration text/headers retained; no generated module is written into original snapshots. Workflow compiler host is fully virtual.

typedWorkflowAdapter.compilation: analyzeWorkflowScript gates type and authoring diagnostics. A shared WorkflowProgram/SiteTable then supplies synthesizeAskSchemas, buildAskSpecs, collectWorldRunCommands and lowerWorkflow. The original lowerer emits an async function body with static site IDs and __host bindings; compilation does not execute the script. Diagnostic9003 retains the command-literal contract and names actual native permissions instead of an unavailable original confirmation dialog.
typedWorkflowAdapter.hostIntegration: DSH isolated ptcRuntime transports compiled Actor operations to native subagents.startContinuable/sendMessage. The same Actor retains one native childId/session across FIFO repeated asks. Native children own model/API, working tools, sandbox permissions, inbox, transcript and activation; no temporary child is spawned for every ask.
typedWorkflowAdapter.results: Typed asks use their compiled per-site schema and the fixed original validate/formatViolations helper. submit_result stages a candidate; authoritative successful native tool results, including enclosing tool completion, commit it. Untyped asks use the completed native assistant text. A typed turn without a committed result fails explicitly. The original plain string type remains untyped: ask() and ask<string>() return final text.
typedWorkflowAdapter.lifecycle: Native jobs own background run status/cancellation. Native PTC cancellation and permission/mode changes abort the adapter; continuable children are interrupted and drained on completion, cancellation and scope disposal. Native child journals remain authoritative; original engine run-journal/replay/resume semantics are not transplanted. A successful top-level return cancels unfinished asks and waits for native cleanup, preserving caught ordinary-ask failures rather than replaying them through an unconditional Promise.all. Actor persona text is durable and literal on cold activation.

savedDefinitions.facade: save_workflow facade=zcode; facade=native preserves the existing JavaScript API
savedDefinitions.dispatch: run_saved_workflow selects create_workflow for marked definitions, workflow for native definitions; metadata argument defaults/types remain source-derived.

typedWorkflowAdapter.presentation: create_workflow returns fixed static graph and causalityGraph data and a native run identity. Progress, phase/log/report narration and results use native jobs/tool outputs; artifactAdapter supplies immutable content versions and a separate run/artifact panel. Static graph data is shown as JSON, not an original live graph UI.
limits: Explicit workflow request or active Pro/Ultra authorization and successful zcode-workflows skill gate remain required
Files/git/world.run are supplied by worldReadAdapter under native permissions; artifactAdapter supplies file/markdown and preset artifact contracts with original validators and native attachments.
No graph amend, original client UI, original Actor scheduler or original durable workflow-engine journal

savedWorkflowAdapter.nativeContract: Native fs observations and tools.execute write/workflow; no alternate execution loop
savedWorkflowAdapter.format: Original YAML block comment + native JavaScript or marked ZCode TypeScript body in .dwf.ts; project before global, scoped lookup/list. facade=zcode inserts // @omaa-workflow-facade: zcode when absent; the marker selects the matching execution entry on read/reuse.
savedWorkflowAdapter.validation: Original metadata and argument validation derived from source; Zod record overload adapted to host 4. Native definitions receive plain JavaScript syntax validation; ZCode definitions receive fixed TypeScript typecheck, analysis, schema synthesis and unsupported-facade checks before save. Defaults/types are validated before reuse, and each execution rechecks its script and current native permissions.
savedWorkflowAdapter.limits: 256 KiB per definition, 256 directory entries/definitions, 1 MiB aggregate list reads
savedWorkflowAdapter.differences: Native definitions dispatch to workflow; marked ZCode definitions dispatch to create_workflow. Original TypeScript compilation/static graphs, world contracts and artifact contracts/presentation are implemented through native adapters; graph amend, original live graph UI and dedicated saved-definition manager remain unavailable. Saved metadata is a definition archive, not the original engine run journal.

worldReadAdapter.sourceContract: Original executeWorldRead/executeGitWorldRead, argument validation, shapes/caps, fixed Git argv/NUL parsers and selected pure filesystem matcher/ripgrep/text-metadata declarations. Raw snapshots stay byte-identical; no NodeFs walker, original workflow engine or IO runtime enters generated modules.
worldReadAdapter.nativeContract: Native fs.resolve/stat/listDir/lstat/readBytes and fs/observed attributed to the actual create_workflow call. Public host-aligned dsh-tool-fs-search.resolveRgPath selects bundled ripgrep, including asar/unpacked and pkg sidecar; native subprocess owns execution and process range. Git/grep use read-only confinement; declared literal world.run uses the current session policy without escalation.
worldReadAdapter.matching: Glob includes hidden/ignored files, skips VCS directories, does not follow lexical symlinks and retains the original literal []/brace rules. Grep retains original rg/ignore flags, JSON parser, line text and path matcher; it does not add --no-ignore or --follow.
worldReadAdapter.text: Native bytes are decoded using original UTF8/UTF16LE/legacy-Chinese detection and iconv-lite0.7.2; BOM is retained, CRLF normalized and bare CR preserved. Read stat-size bound and native transport limits remain host differences.
worldReadAdapter.execution: Nonzero numeric exit without execution error returns original exitCode/stdout/stderr shape. Timeout/cancellation/spawn failures/incomplete observations reject; original error name/code is preserved through JSON bindings. Complete outputs are retained as prefix and rejected above each cap instead of using lossy native tail collection. Managed range and independently bounded caller-owned pipe drain settle on return, abort and observation failures.
differences: No per-command native Bash approval path or permission escalation; current workflow tool boundary and native policy apply.
No original world journal/replay, graph amend or live graph/world UI; artifactAdapter separately supplies artifact contracts and native presentation.
Native transport/file-race/process-provider limits remain; no universal escaped-descendant guarantee.
worldReadAdapter.verification: test/installed-zcode-world.test.mjs single installed native fixture: original glob semantics, UTF16 BOM/CRLF, bundled search/Git, undefined positional args, relative argv, nonzero result/catchable caps, native workspace-write and parent Ask background cancellation. worldReadAdapter.modelVerification: One configured opencode-zen/space-bunny-free task loaded the actual zcode-workflows skill and executed create_workflow to read/glob a native fact file, inspect native Git main branch and run a literal argv command; all returned values matched. This short task does not establish model-wide fidelity or stability.

artifactAdapter.sourceContract: Fixed 29628c9 original-byte publish/spec/primary contracts, caps, JSON probe/hash, parse/fold/palette and complete ChartView/chart leaves. Builder extracts named pure declarations and adapts import tokens only; no WorkflowEngine, scheduler, provider/account runtime or original blob/journal backend is bundled.
artifactAdapter.content: await artifact.file/markdown publishes immutable snapshots and returns {id,version}. Native root/realpath containment applies to file inputs. Missing/outside/oversize/primary publication failures preserve catchable original error codes; successful versions survive later workspace changes and whole-host cold restart. Primary is sticky under the original validator.
artifactAdapter.presets: Top-level artifact.chart/table/metrics/board declarations snapshot the spec at call time; later caller mutation does not alter it. Tagged report(item,id) uses original JSON probe and budgets. Invalid declarations or reports fail the parent run even if the script catches a local error. Original parse/fold/palette supports paginated reports and table key upsert.
artifactAdapter.storage: Native storage Domain omaa_zcode_workflows v1 retains only small per-run summaries. Full metadata, content versions and report items are native content-addressed file attachment refs; no separate blob store or native journal format change. Reads authorize session/run/version, reject cross-session access, and cold-inspect without activating or appending to the native session journal.
artifactAdapter.presentation: Separate workflow artifact sidebar, tool-result View artifacts entry, per-run navigation and actual native Stop. Visible-only reads use singleflight, pending reread and stale-response filtering. Exact upstream ChartView uses pinned Recharts 3.8.0 via lazy loading and local error boundary; Table/Metrics/Board presentation adapts DSH CSS. Native attachments.fileHostPath selects immutable snapshots for native Text/Markdown/document previews. Graph/causality are actual static JSON only.
differences: No original engine journal/replay/resume, original scheduler or account/client runtime.
No live graph or graph amend; static graph/causality JSON is not an original dynamic graph UI.
Native Domain/attachments/session authorization and DSH presentation replace original storage/host integrations.

Unknown provider backoff is not inferred. Native Domain/attachments remain authoritative for presentation; no original engine execution or replay journal.
graphProjectionAdapter.presentation: Retained original Timeline and WorkflowRunPhaseList, 37 original UI code files plus styles and Chinese/English locale; not ReactFlow. Native display adapter supplies actual facts. Tailwind 4.2.2 produces source CSS at build time from an isolated temporary build, not a runtime dependency. lucide-react1.17.0 is a production dependency compatible with React18 peers.
graphProjectionAdapter.amend: Original Amend stops the predecessor and starts a successor run inheriting cache and the exact completed Actor transcript prefix. Same-run changes are concurrency retune; resume requires identical script bytes. OMAA Amend is not wired: stop/new without cache/prefix inheritance is not equivalent. A dedicated public continuity provider can seed the old Actor complete completed prefix while the manager retains new parent/descriptor/permissions; a host modification is not inherently required.
